syllabus_source: Authoritative RTU syllabus document provided by user, effective 2018-19, applicable to 2025-26 admission year

entries.subject: Advanced Engineering Mathematics-I
topics: Unit 1: Finite differences, operator relations, interpolation formulae (Newton's forward/backward, Gauss's, Stirling's), unequal intervals, divided difference, Lagrange's, numerical differentiation, numerical integration (Trapezoidal, Simpson's 1/3, 3/8)
Unit 2: ODE solutions (Taylor's series, Euler's, Modified Euler's, RK4, Milne's, Adams), polynomial/transcendental equations (Bisection, Newton-Raphson, Regula-Falsi)
Unit 3: Laplace Transform (definition, existence, properties, unit step, Dirac delta, Heaviside, periodic functions, inverse, convolution, integral evaluation, ODE solutions)
Unit 4: Fourier Transform (complex, sine, cosine transforms, properties, inverse, convolution, PDEs: 1D heat equation, 1D wave equation)
Unit 5: Z-Transform (definition, properties, convolution theorem, inverse, difference equations)

entries.subject: Managerial Economics and Financial Accounting
topics: Unit 1: Basic Economic Concepts (nature/scope of economics, deductive/inductive methods, static/dynamic, economic problems/scarcity/choice, circular flow, national income concepts/measurement)
Unit 2: Demand and Supply Analysis (demand types/determinants/function/elasticity, demand forecasting purpose/determinants/methods, supply determinants/function/elasticity)

Unit 3: Production and Cost Analysis (production function/variable proportions/returns to scale/optimization/least-cost combination/isoquants/explicit/implicit/fixed/variable/opportunity/sunk costs/cost function/cost curves/cost/output decisions/estimation)
Unit 4: Market Structure and Pricing Theory (perfect competition/monopoly/monopolistic competition/oligopoly)
Unit 5: Financial Statement Analysis (balance sheet/P&L/financial ratio analysis/cash-flow/funds-flow/comparative statements/analysis/interpretation/capital budgeting techniques)

entries.subject: Engineering Mechanics
pdfs: 22.Mechanical-Short-Notes(D)/1.SHORT NOTES For gate Mechanical-1/1. Gate Notes-Strength of Materials Short Notes(s)_optimize.pdf (indirect SOM coverage)
22.Mechanical-Short-Notes(D)/1.SHORT NOTES For gate Mechanical-1/2. Gate Notes-Theory of Machines Short Notes(s)_optimize.pdf (indirect TOM coverage - also listed in TOM)
topics: Unit 1: Statics of particles/rigid bodies (fundamental laws, transmissibility, resultants/resolution, moments/couples, Varignon's theorem, force resolution, free-body diagrams, equilibrium, Lami's theorem); Plane trusses (types/support conditions/loading/determinacy/basic assumptions/method of joints/method of sections); Virtual work (principle, active-force diagrams, stability of equilibrium)

Unit 2: Centroid, Moment of Inertia, and Lifting Machines (centroid/CG, moment of inertia, parallel-axis theorem, perpendicular-axis theorem, radius of gyration, composite sections, polar moment, solid bodies); Lifting machines (MA/VR/efficiency/ideal machine/reversibility/law of machine/pulley systems/wheel/axle/Weston's block/worm/wheel/winch crabs/screw jack/differential screw jack)

Unit 3: Friction and Belt/Rope Drives (friction: types/laws/angle of friction/angle of repose/ladder friction/wedge friction/belt friction); Belt/rope drives: types/velocity ratio/slip effect/crowning/belt length/flat-belt tensions/power transmission/V-belt vs flat belt advantages/disadvantages)

Unit 4: Kinematics and Kinetics (particles/rigid bodies: velocity/acceleration/types of motion/equations/rectangular components/angular velocity/acceleration/radial/transverse/projectile motion on horizontal/inclined planes/relative motion); kinetics: Newton's second law/rectangular coordinates/radial/transverse components/rigid bodies in plane/D'Alembert's principle)

Unit 5: Work, Energy, Power, Impulse, and Momentum (work/energy/power: force/weight/spring force/couple/power/efficiency/energy/KE of rigid body/work-energy principle/conservative/non-conservative forces/conservation of energy; impulse/momentum: linear/angular momentum/impulse/momentum principles/linear impulse-momentum/angular momentum/impulse/conservation of angular momentum/rigid bodies angular momentum/central impact/oblique impact/variable mass systems/rockets)

entries.subject: Engineering Thermodynamics
pdfs: 22.Mechanical-Short-Notes(D)/1.SHORT NOTES For gate Mechanical-1/6. Gate Notes-Thermodynamics Short Notes(s)_optimize.pdf
topics: Unit 1: Basic Concepts, Zeroth Law, and First Law (system/surroundings/properties/energy/equilibrium/processes/work/modes; Zeroth law/temperature scales; First law/elementary processes/steady-flow energy equation/unsteady-flow energy equation)

Unit 2: Second Law, Entropy, and Availability (heat engines/pumps/refrigerators/Second law/Kelvin-Planck/Clausius equivalence/reversible/irreversible processes/Carnot engine/efficiency/principle/thermodynamic temperature scale/Clausius inequality; Entropy/calculation of change/principle of increase/T-s diagrams/control volume analysis; Availability/available energy/loss/availability function/irreversibility)

Unit 3: Thermodynamic Properties of Fluids, Ideal Gases, and Real Gases (pure substances/phase/p-v-T data/steam properties/steam tables/Mollier chart; Ideal gas/real gas/internal energy/enthalpy/specific heats/equations of state/Dalton's law/Gibbs-Dalton law/gas mixtures properties)

Unit 4: Thermodynamic Relations and Power Cycles (thermodynamic variables/independent/dependent variables/Maxwell's relations/relations involving entropy/enthalpy/internal energy/Joule-Thomson coefficient/Clapeyron equation; Power cycles: Otto, Diesel, Dual, Brayton, Ericsson)

Unit 5: Vapour Power Cycles (Rankine cycle/effect of operating conditions on Rankine-cycle efficiency/ideal working fluid properties/reheat cycle/regenerative cycle/bleeding/extraction cycle/feedwater-heating cycle/cogeneration cycle)
entries.exam_objective: university_internal_assessments_midterms_end_semester_gate_preparation - HIGHEST OVERLAP subject (90%+ shared between RTU and GATE)

entries.subject: Material Science and Engineering
topics: Unit 1: Crystal Structure, Defects, and Deformation (BCC/FCC/HCP structures/unit cell/crystallographic planes/directions/Miller indices/imperfections: point/line/surface/volume defects/Frank-Read source/elastic/plastic deformation/Bauschinger effect/slip/twinning/strain hardening/cold/hot working/recovery/recrystallization/grain growth)

Unit 2: Classification of Engineering Materials and Phase Diagrams (solidification/metals/alloys/nucleation/crystal growth/phase transformation principles/phase rule/equilibrium diagrams/binary systems: complete solubility/limited solid solubility/isomorphous systems/Hume-Rothery rules/limited terminal solid solubility/peritectic transformations/allotropic changes/Iron-carbon diagram/eutectic/peritectic/eutectoid/peritectoid reactions/microstructures)

Unit 3: Transformation Diagrams and Heat Treatment (isothermal transformation diagrams/cooling curves/critical cooling rate/austenite from pearlite/austenite to pearlite/heat treatment: full annealing/stress-relief/spheroidizing/normalizing/hardening/tempering/hardenability/Jominy end-quench test/austempering/martempering/case hardening: carburising/nitriding/cyaniding/carbonitriding/flame hardening/induction hardening)

Unit 4: Non-Metallic Materials, Alloys, and Metals (polymer types/commodity/engineering polymers: PE/PP/PS/PVC/PMMA/PET/PC/PA/ABS/PI/PAI/PPO/PPS/PEEK/PTFE/urea/formaldehyde/phenol/formaldehyde/alloys: substitutional/interstitial solid solutions/ferrous/non-ferrous metals: Mn/Si/Cr/Mo/V/Ti/W effects on steel/stainless/tool/HSLA steels)

Unit 5: Mechanical Testing, Steels, Ceramics, Composites, and Nanomaterials (mechanical properties/fracture types/tensile/compression/shear testing/Brinell/Vickers/Rockwell hardness/Izod/Charpy impact/fatigue/creep; steels/cast irons/BIS standards/ceramics: Al2O3/SiC/Si3N4/PSZ/FRP/particulate composites/resin plastics/nanomaterials: nanostructured materials/nanoclusters/nanocrystals)

entries.subject: Mechanics of Solids / Strength of Materials
pdfs: 22.Mechanical-Short-Notes(D)/1.SHORT NOTES For gate Mechanical-1/1. Gate Notes-Strength of Materials Short Notes(s)_optimize.pdf
topics: Unit 1: Stress and Strain (elementary definitions/stress-strain relationships/elastic/plastic/viscoelastic behavior/tensile/compressive/shear/stress-strain curves/Hooke's law/Poisson's ratio/elastic constants for isotropic Hookean/anisotropic/orthotropic/tensile/compressive/shear stress/strain/thermal stresses/composite bars/static equilibrium equations/free-body diagrams/strain energy due to axial loading)

Unit 2: Members Subjected to Flexural Loads (simple bending theory/bending-moment diagrams/shear-force diagrams for different loading/support conditions/bending stresses/section modulus/transverse shear-stress distribution: circular/hollow circular/I-box/T/Angle sections/strain energy due to bending)

Unit 3: Principal Planes, Stresses, Strains, and Elastic Failure (principal stresses/strains under combined axial/bending/torsional loads/max normal/shear stresses/equivalent bending/twisting moment/Mohr's circle of stress/strain/theories of elastic failure: need/different theories/significance/comparison/applications)

Unit 4: Torsion and Stability of Equilibrium (torsional shear stress:solid/hollow/stepped circular shafts/angular deflection/power transmission/strain energy; stability: instability/elastic stability/long/short columns/ideal struts/Euler's crippling-load formula for different end conditions/equivalent length/eccentric loading/Rankine formula/other empirical relations)

Unit 5: Beam Deflection and Thin-Walled Pressure Vessels (relations between deflection/BM/SF/load/beam/shaft deflection under static loading: area-moment method/direct-integration method; thin-walled pressure vessels: cylindrical vessel stresses/spherical vessel stresses)

entries.subject: Machine Drawing Practice
topics: Assembly drawing: sectioning and BOM; lathe tailstock; shaper tool head; swivel machine vice; one assembly drawing sheet
Detailed part drawings: from assembly drawings, fits/tolerances, surface-finish symbols, BIS codes; check valve and junction valve examples; one drawing sheet

Computer-aided drafting: AutoCAD/ProE/Creo/SolidWorks introduction; 2D drafting; 3D modelling; advanced 3D; assembly modelling; feature modification/manipulation; detailing; surface modelling; one problem for each CAD area

entries.subject: Materials Testing Lab
topics: 1. Crystal structures using models (BCC/FCC/HCP, tetrahedral/octahedral voids); Material identification of ~50 common items
2. Specimen preparation: cutting, grinding, polishing, etching
3. Microstructure comparison: mild steel, grey cast iron, brass, copper
4. Heat-treatment experiments: annealing, normalizing, quenching, case hardening, hardness comparison
5. Steel microstructure at different cooling rates, white cast iron microstructure
6. Tensile, compressive, shear, torsion tests for mechanical properties
7. Rockwell, Vickers, Brinell hardness determination
8. Impact testing and resilience determination
9. Fatigue testing and strength determination
10. Bending tests and Young's modulus determination through beam deflection
11. Creep testing using creep-testing machine
